column1: # THE RESTRICTED MEDIA MODEL LICENCE REGISTER. One row per fetched FILE whose
# licence is outside PERMISSIVE_LICENCES, or that belongs to a restricted
# artefact's foundation set. A row here is NOT read by
# refusing non-commercial rows in licence-register.tsv). It is read by
# which admits a row only for a request from a project whose checkout holds a
# SSHSIG by an enrolled per-host key). Restricted weights are fetched only on
# the user's machine, after acknowledgement; they are never bundled in an
# image or a release. TAB-separated, no interpreter.
# Columns: the permissive register's eight, then two more:
#   repo            Hugging Face owner/name, or the publisher's repo when the
#                   weights are not on the Hub (see the RVM note)
#   revision        the publisher's pinned revision: a commit sha, or `md5:<base64>`
#                   for the RVM GCS object, which has none (as upstream verifies it)
#   file            the path the fetcher names, as images/imagegen-corridorkey/weights.tsv
#                   (order 1956-ucix) spells it; the gate matches repo, revision,
#                   file and sha256 exactly, so both files MUST agree
#   sha256          the file's sha256 (Hub API ?blobs=true, or hashed in full)
#   spdx            licence id as the register spells it; the obligation table
#                   in licence_consent.rs is keyed by it
#   gated           the Hub's gated flag; must be false (nobody clicks through
#                   gated terms on a user's behalf)
#   card            the model card URL the licence was read from
#   licence_sha256  sha256 of the licence TEXT the obligations were read from,
#                   so a changed licence needs a new acknowledgement; or
#                   `pending:<url>` when the text could not be fetched where the
#                   row was written. A pending row is never admitted.
# The rows are generated from images/imagegen-corridorkey/weights.tsv (order
# 1956-ucix), one per file infer.py needs, with the obligation classes and the
# licence hash added per licence id. Regenerate from that file; do not re-derive.
# the CORRIDOR KEY LICENCE v2.0, a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 variant. Its LICENSE file at
# the pinned revision hashes to c92ce56f…; the obligations are its sections 2
# to 5. Verified on the Hub API 2026-11-02. Its three frozen foundation models
# follow, each under its own licence (README "Foundation models" at the same
# C-RADIOv4-SO400M: the NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement (June 2024) is a
# PDF on developer.download.nvidia.com that this host could not fetch
# (connection reset at the egress), so its hash is pending and the row is not
# admissible until someone pins it. The snapshot's config and trust_remote_code
# modules are rows too, since foundations.py loads the directory; the .pth.tar
# is a pickle and is never fetched.
# MoGe-2 ViT-B: MIT. The Hub repo carries no LICENSE file; the hash is of
# microsoft/MoGe's LICENSE on GitHub (main, 2026-11-02). The file is model.pt,
# a pickle: the imagegen fetcher's ALLOWED_SUFFIXES refuse it, so 1956-ucix's
# CUDA image must fetch and load it itself, inside its sandbox.
# RVM small (Recurrent Video Masked Autoencoders, google-deepmind/representations4d):
# CC-BY-4.0. The weights are not on the Hub: they are the GCS object
# was computed over the full 270,086,372-byte object on 2026-11-02.
# The licence hash is the SPDX CC-BY-4.0 text.
